articles.summary: announces the appointment of Dwyane Wade as Chief Performance Officer for REVOLVE Man and FWRD Man , marking a significant milestone in the continued expansion of the company's rapidly growing menswear business. A cultural icon whose influence spans sports, fashion, business, and entertainment, Wade has been a long-standing partner of REVOLVE Group and brings a deep understanding of both REVOLVE and FWRD's brand identities and their distinct consumers. As Chief Performance Officer , he will serve as the face and strategic advisor behind men's fashion initiatives across REVOLVE and FWRD , translating that perspective into the world of fashion, sports, culture, wellness, and more. Wade will help shape the vision for REVOLVE and FWRD's men's business through product curation and brand-building initiatives, while providing insight into category expansion, consumer trends, brand marketing, and partnership opportunities. articles.summary: today announced the expansion of its long-standing partnership with Kendall Jenner , elevating her role to Global Creative Director of FWRD and naming her a REVOLVE Los Angeles Ambassador . One of fashion's most influential voices, Jenner has been an integral part of the REVOLVE ecosystem for nearly a decade. Following early collaborations with the brand, she was appointed Creative Director of FWRD in 2021. Since then, she has helped shape the luxury retailer's fashion authority through curated product edits, emerging designer discovery, and elevated brand storytelling. As Global Creative Director of FWRD , Jenner will continue to guide the luxury retailer's digital creative direction across brand curation, monthly trend edits, and major marketing initiatives. In addition to this expanded role at FWRD , Jenner will now serve as a REVOLVE Los Angeles ambassador, extending her partnership across the REVOLVE Group portfolio. articles.title: REVOLVE Group Elevates Long-Term Partnership with Kendall Jenner, Expanding Role to Global Creative Director of FWRD and REVOLVE Los Angeles Ambassador

articles.summary: The Greater Miami location marks the brand's third permanent store, bringing the REVOLVE experience to one of the country's most premier retail destinations. , the next-generation fashion retailer, today announced the opening of its newest and first Florida permanent retail location at Aventura Mall , located just north of Miami. The 4,512-square-foot store, officially opened to the public on September 29, marks the next step in REVOLVE's strategic retail expansion, bringing the brand's curated shopping experience to one of the nation's leading luxury shopping destinations. The new store builds on the success of the brand's flagship location at The Grove in Los Angeles and its boutique store in Aspen , further extending REVOLVE's omnichannel presence. Designed as a destination with its own identity, the Aventura Mall store features a thoughtfully curated assortment tailored to the Miami customer, reflecting the region's year-round warm climate, vibrant nightlife, and active lifestyle.
articles.title: REVOLVE Opens New Store at Aventura Mall, Expanding Its Physical Retail Presence
